description: Render a preview of an .icon bundle. Uses Apple's ictool for Liquid Glass rendering by default (falls back to flat composite if Icon Composer is not installed). Supports canvas backgrounds and zoom.

appearance.description: Appearance mode to preview (omit for default/light)

apple_preset.description: Apple Icon Composer preset background (overrides canvas_bg)

canvas_bg_color.description: Custom hex color for canvas background

flat.description: Force flat composite rendering (skip ictool/Liquid Glass)

output_path.description: Output path for the PNG file

return_image.description: Return the rendered image inline as base64 (default true)

zoom.description: Zoom level — icon size relative to canvas (1.0 = full canvas, 0.5 = half size)

name: export_preview
